About.metaDescription: Learn about Eren Teknik Engineering's founding story, mission, vision, and engineering philosophy.
About.heroSubtitle: Adding value to Turkey's industrial infrastructure since 2000.
About.storyP1: Eren Teknik Engineering was founded in 2000 in Ankara as a small electrical installation firm. Our founder set out with a vision to offer an alternative to the fragmented service approach in the industry: a holistic approach that unifies four core engineering disciplines under one roof.
About.storyP2: Initially focused on electrical installation projects, the firm recognized its clients' need for a reliable partner across different disciplines, investing in automation, mechanical, and construction engineering capabilities. This expansion laid the foundation for our multi-disciplinary structure, now proven across more than 200 industrial projects.
About.missionText: To enhance our clients' operational efficiency in industrial and commercial projects through integrated solutions born from the synergy of four engineering disciplines, delivering projects on time and within budget.
About.visionText: To become the reference point in Turkey's integrated engineering services. To lead the industry as a firm that applies — not just follows — technology, and sets — not just meets — standards.

electrical.metaDescription: Comprehensive electrical engineering services from low voltage installations to energy efficiency consulting.
electrical.heroSubtitle: Designing and implementing safe, efficient, and standards-compliant electrical systems.

lowVoltage.title: Low Voltage Installations
lowVoltage.description: Design, installation, and commissioning of sub-1000V power distribution systems in industrial and commercial facilities. Including panel design, cabling, and protection systems.

mediumVoltage.title: Medium Voltage Systems
mediumVoltage.description: Design and implementation of 1-36 kV medium voltage switchgear, transformer stations, and distribution systems. Full compliance with national grid standards.

lighting.title: Lighting Design
lighting.description: Interior and exterior lighting design, energy-efficient LED solutions, emergency lighting systems, and lighting automation integration.

grounding.title: Grounding & Lightning Protection
grounding.description: Ground resistance measurements, grounding grid design, lightning protection systems (LPS), and surge protection solutions.

energyEfficiency.title: Energy Efficiency Consulting
energyEfficiency.description: Energy audits, power quality analysis, compensation systems, and planning and implementation of energy saving projects.

automation.metaDescription: From PLC programming to SCADA systems, industrial automation and smart building control solutions.
automation.heroSubtitle: Smart control systems that digitalize and optimize your industrial processes.

plc.title: PLC Programming & Integration
plc.description: Programming, configuration, and integration of Siemens, ABB, Schneider, and Allen-Bradley PLC systems. Expert team in Ladder, FBD, and SCL languages.

scada.title: SCADA Systems
scada.description: Design, installation, and commissioning of centralized monitoring and control systems. Real-time data acquisition, alarm management, and reporting infrastructure.

bms.title: Building Management Systems (BMS)
bms.description: Smart building management systems for unified control of HVAC, lighting, access control, and energy management from a single platform.

industrial.title: Industrial Automation
industrial.description: Production lines, conveyor systems, robot integration, and industrial process automation. Industry 4.0 compatible solutions.

processControl.title: Process Control Systems
processControl.description: DCS and hybrid control systems, instrumentation, process optimization, and advanced control algorithms.

mechanical.metaDescription: From HVAC systems to fire safety, industrial and commercial mechanical installation solutions.
mechanical.heroSubtitle: Mechanical installation solutions delivering comfort, safety, and efficiency together.

hvac.title: HVAC Systems
hvac.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of heating, cooling, ventilation, and air conditioning systems. VRF, chiller, and central system solutions.

fire.title: Fire Detection & Suppression
fire.description: Design and implementation of fire detection, alarm, and suppression systems. Sprinkler, FM-200, CO₂, and foam suppression systems.

plumbing.title: Plumbing Systems
plumbing.description: Design of clean water, waste water, and stormwater systems. Pump stations, pre-treatment preparation, and plumbing infrastructure.

gas.title: Natural Gas Installation
gas.description: Industrial and commercial natural gas internal installation projects, pressure reduction stations, and gas detection systems. Including utility approval processes.

compressedAir.title: Compressed Air Systems
compressedAir.description: Industrial compressed air production, distribution, and treatment systems. Compressor selection, pipeline design, and energy efficiency optimization.

construction.metaDescription: From reinforced concrete design to project management, industrial and commercial construction engineering solutions.
construction.heroSubtitle: Strong foundations, durable structures. Building your project's physical infrastructure.

concrete.title: Reinforced Concrete Design
concrete.description: Earthquake-resistant reinforced concrete structural design for industrial facilities, factory buildings, and commercial structures. Static and dynamic analyses, formwork and reinforcement projects.

steel.title: Steel Structures
steel.description: Prefabricated steel structures, steel roof systems, mezzanine floors, and industrial steel construction projects. Calculation, detail, and fabrication drawings.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Projects
infrastructure.description: Road, sewage, water supply, drainage systems, and site development projects. Infrastructure solutions for organized industrial zones and industrial sites.

industrial.title: Industrial Facility Construction
industrial.description: Turnkey industrial facility construction. Coordinated execution of all engineering disciplines from foundation excavation to roof cladding.

management.title: Project Management
management.description: Construction project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and site coordination. Progress tracking, quality control, and occupational safety management.
